models_evaluated: seven reader LLMs from four model families (not named in the abstract)

links.outcome: Propagation of injected diagnostic overcalls and bloat from LLM-authored note content into downstream LLM outputs
links.effect: Injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates varying by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics. LLM summary notes modestly but consistently degraded hospital-course generation versus copy-forward and templated text.
links.quote: Second, injected overcalls reappeared in downstream outputs at rates that varied by reader model, without detectable changes in standard quality metrics.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing the safety implications (propagation of error and performance degradation) of LLMs reading records contaminated with prior LLM-generated text (note bloat and diagnostic overcall).
